text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for giving me some time the other 
day. 
So... without further ado, I've brought my 
proposal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Here's my idea! 
"Find Santa and the Reindeer! 
Mystery-Solving Treasure Hunt Game"!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The core of it is solving riddles. Mejiro 
Umamusume will dress up as Santa and hold 
clues, so the key is sharing info about 
where they are to clear the game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A riddle-solving game, huh... 
Those are really popular lately, so I bet 
new fans would enjoy it too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I want to make it an event that even 
new fans who don't know much about the 
Mejiro family can totally enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A while back, I asked one of my freestyle 
friends what they thought of the Mejiro 
family. 
And they said, "Their refined aura is 
insane. They're on a whole other level 
lol."

text_block_list.name: Dober & Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Another level? 
...Straw? My goodness~, what kind of straw 
would that be~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I mean it felt like "we live in 
totally different worlds." 
Though I kinda get it, ya know? Like, 
there's a barrier to entry, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So when new fans come to Christmas Night, 
I don't want them to feel like they don't 
belong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Plus, in this game, helping each other out 
is totally encouraged! I want to design it 
so that the more you cooperate with other 
fans, the easier it is to beat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want the fans to actively mingle with 
each other! 
That way, new fans won't feel out of 
place, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
An event where new fans and long-time fans 
can hype each other up and have fun 
together. 
—*That's* the kind of event I want to 
make!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that is simply wonderful, 
Palmer-sama~. 
A fresh breeze born from fans interacting 
with one another... I am quite looking 
forward to it as well♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm so glad to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's an idea I came up with thanks to my 
experiences over there, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, an amusement park would be 
a splendid venue. 
It suits a riddle-solving treasure hunt 
game wonderfully~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Speaking of the venue, 
can we borrow the amusement park your 
family owns, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I spoke with my father and have 
already made a provisional booking for a 
private hire~. 
Furthermore, for a rest area on the day, 
we can arrange simple log cabins—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome! You've already arranged 
that much!? 
All right, let's start planning the venue 
setup then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Upload complete. 
The website should be live now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let me try submitting a test 
application through the form.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This year's Christmas Night website 
is done! 
It looks so stylish~! Wait, Dober, you 
made this!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, while checking the manual... and Air 
Groove-senpai introduced me to someone 
from the student council's web team.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. 
Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Dober & Ryan
text_block_list.text: .........She complimented me!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-sama~. I have sent the presentation 
materials to your smartphone, so could you 
please take a look~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Hmm... Yeah, okay. 
Got it! It's well organized and super easy 
to follow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
With this, our prep for the Mejiro family 
presentation is complete! 
Let's go knock 'em dead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh~! Indeed~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —That concludes our proposal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
It is a very well-thought-out plan. The 
overall framework poses no issue. 
However, there is one thing... Please 
reconsider the "Mystery-Solving Treasure 
Hunt Game".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...May I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
A game that anyone can enjoy is a fine 
endeavor. 
However, regarding the encouragement of 
interaction among fans... we hold some 
concerns.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
Those who have loved the Mejiro family for 
generations and our newer fans may have 
rather different ways of enjoying 
themselves, do they not?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, it comes down to a 
"difference in vibe." We wish to avoid a 
situation where such a gap prevents anyone 
from enjoying the event.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...It's true that our long-time fans might 
feel bewildered. But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, bewilderment is par for the course 
with innovation. We understand that. 
Should my concerns prove to be unfounded, 
there will be no issue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In other words... we need to prove there's 
nothing to worry about, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
I am glad you understand. That is our only 
point of contention. 
We would like to hear your revised plan at 
the next board meeting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......Still zero today...... What should I 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We're not getting any event sign-ups from 
new fans at all...
